_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_pd#2, and a falsification of its Signal. Substituting rigidphase for boundaryphase in upstream particle_sph_2d_pdbody_gravity.4C.yaml produces neither 'unknown particle phase: rigidphase' nor 'rigidphase incompatible with PD interaction'. rigidphase is a valid type; the deck parses, the run completes, and 4C emits no warning at all. What actually happens is that the rigid container applies ZERO force to the pdphase body, which free-falls: velx comes out as 2.354e+02, i.e. g*t for g=9810 and t=3000*8e-6, and vely is O(1e-10). Eight of ten result tests fail while the pd_damage_phi tests still pass, so a reader checking only for cracks sees a healthy run. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Result check failed with 8 errors out of 10 tests

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: keep boundaryphase in the second arm. The container then carries load again, the free-fall velocity disappears, the deck passes its own result tests and EXIT_RIGIDPHASE becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
